summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests ASP2138, given alone or with other cancer drugs, in adults with stomach, gastroesophageal junction, or pancreatic cancer whose tumors express CLDN18.2. ASP2138 is given into a vein (intravenous infusion) or under the skin (subcutaneous injection), with doses increased in small groups; how long or how often it is given is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability and aims to find a suitable dose; a formal main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa ASP2138, administrado solo o con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en adultos con cáncer de estómago, de la unión gastroesofágica o de páncreas cuyos tumores expresan CLDN18.2. ASP2138 se administra por vena (infusión intravenosa) o debajo de la piel (inyección subcutánea), con dosis que aumentan en grupos pequeños; no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se administra. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad y busca encontrar una dosis adecuada; no se indica una medida de resultado principal formal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic stomach, GEJ, or pancreatic adenocarcinoma
Tumor sample positive for CLDN18.2 by central immunohistochemistry testing
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 within 28 days before first dose
Predicted life expectancy of at least 12 weeks
not_for: Need for medicines that suppress the immune system
Blockages or bleeding in the gut
Specific uncontrollable cancers or specific infections
New York Heart Association Class III or IV heart condition
